name: wpcom-to-pressable-migration
description: Move Team 51 sites from WordPress.com (Atomic) to Pressable: a read-only audit that reports blockers, decisions and manual work and generates a per-site runbook; a guided run that creates the Pressable site with the team51 CLI, copies it with Reprint run on Pressable (a rehearsal, then a final pull), switches deploys to Pressable's GitHub integration with the .deployignore allowlist, and changes DNS; and verification checks at each stage.
